title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-25

ai_review.summary: Decent recording that's a bit rough on newer material, but features a great Alligator jam.
ai_review.review: The tape sounds fine overall, though reviewers note it’s a little rough around the edges, especially when tackling the newer songs. The highlight of the show is an energetic Alligator jam that stands out despite any technical imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review; reviewer praises the performance (especially the Alligator jam) while mentioning minor roughness, leading to a solid but not exceptional rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall acceptable sound, though a little rough on newer songs; no specific issues noted beyond that.
